text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Dia, you're really into that book,
huh?
What's it about?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's called The Encyclopedia of World Superstitions. It's all about how the smallest things you do—or don't do—can bring about various jinxes.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hee hee. With so many jinxes, it's fun to
plan out
how I'll overcome each and
every one of them! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you're always taking on new
challenges,
huh? You must really love it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
This one looks particularly intriguing. "If
two
people attempt to meet up at a
festival, one will
always get lost
somehow."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whooa! Festivals are my thing! We
should try it
out next time!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wait, we've been to lots of festivals
together, but
aren't you always getting
lost even without the
jinx?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You might be right... Hehe, and
when I think
about it, there might not be
any need for us to
overcome this one,
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Because, Kita, even if we do get split up, you always manage to find me. ♪
